scenes.text: This tutorial covers Installation with Conda. Create an isolated Python environment and install spaCR without changing the rest of your system.
Open Installation with Conda from the spaCR section. Install Miniconda, Anaconda, or another Conda-compatible manager, then create an environment with Python three point twelve.
In the main configuration area, activate the environment and confirm that its Python and pip executables belong to that environment.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. Install spaCR with pip inside the active environment; the conda-forge package is still coming soon.
When the workflow finishes, launch spaCR from the same environment and keep it isolated from unrelated projects.
